As Apple (AAPL) Valuation Rose, Karp Capital Management Has Upped Position; As Ecolab (ECL) Stock Rose, State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company Boosted Holding by $1.75 Million
June 2, 2018 - By Michael Collier
State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company increased its stake in Ecolab Inc (ECL) by 30.2% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company bought 12,807 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.64% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 55,212 shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.57 million, up from 42,405 at the end of the previous reported quarter. State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company who had been investing in Ecolab Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $41.43B market cap company. The stock increased 0.69% or $0.99 during the last trading session, reaching $143.6. About 766,650 shares traded. Ecolab Inc. (NYSE:ECL) has risen 11.05% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.52% the S&P500.
Karp Capital Management Corp increased its stake in Apple (AAPL) by 632.85% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Karp Capital Management Corp bought 15,815 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 18,314 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.07M, up from 2,499 at the end of the previous reported quarter. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
